2609.06341.title: Linear Algebra Foundations of Efficient Attention: A Phase Reversal in Rank Collapse Under SVD Compression
2609.06341.paper_summary: Linear algebra provides the framework of concepts (matrix rank, singular value decomposition (SVD), and eigendecomposition) that modern artificial intelligence employs to encode, compress, and propagate information through neural networks. This paper unifies fourteen separate peer-reviewed works analyzing the usage of these techniques in the context of transformer-based foundation model research, focusing on three areas of the topic: derivations and properties of self-attention matrices' output rank, compression methods that purposefully utilize this phenomenon, and the low-rank key-value (KV) cache projection and its semiseparable-matrix duality to linear attention and state-space structured models. We were motivated to conduct this work after observing an open problem in this literature: the interplay of the mentioned compression methods with natural rank collapse of the network. With this paper, we report an original finding that using SVD compression of attention projections actually has the opposite effect on the rank collapse of the network: while it strongly suppresses it at initialization, it accelerates on pretrained models (for GPT-2 124M, GPT-2 Medium 355M, and Pythia-160M) with minimal risk of object aliasing artifacts appearing (verified on all compression ratios) and is consistent across four rank estimation methods. A controlled causal decomposition of the effect in both settings showed that the reason for this behavior can be explained by the choice of the subspace SVD makes when compressing the matrix better than the reduction of the operator norm it achieves, explaining roughly 76% of the effect at initialization and 83% on the pretrained weights, providing a refinement to the calibration-aware compression viewpoint and an explanation of why it outperformed naive SVD truncation.
2609.06341.paper_summary_zh: 線性代數提供了現代人工智慧所使用的概念框架（矩陣秩、奇異值分解（SVD）和特徵分解），用於通過神經網絡編碼、壓縮和傳播信息。本文統一了十四篇獨立的同行評審作品，分析了這些技術在基於Transformer的基礎模型研究中的使用，重點關注該主題的三個領域：自注意矩陣輸出秩的推導和性質、故意利用這一現象的壓縮方法，以及低秩鍵值（KV）緩存投影及其與線性注意和狀態空間結構模型的半可分矩陣對偶性。我們受到啟發進行這項工作，因為觀察到文獻中存在一個未解決的問題：上述壓縮方法與網絡的自然秩崩潰之間的相互作用。通過這篇論文，我們報告了一個原創發現，即使用SVD壓縮注意投影實際上對網絡的秩崩潰產生了相反的效果：雖然它在初始化時強烈抑制了秩崩潰，但在預訓練模型（對於GPT-2 124M、GPT-2 Medium 355M和Pythia-160M）上卻加速了崩潰，且出現物件混疊伪影的風險極小（在所有壓縮比上均已驗證），並且在四種秩估計方法中保持一致。在這兩種情境下對效果進行的控制因果分解顯示，這種行為的原因可以通過SVD在壓縮矩陣時所選擇的子空間來解釋，這一解釋優於其所達到的算子範數的減少，約解釋了初始化時76%的效果和預訓練權重時83%的效果，為校準感知壓縮觀點提供了細化，並解釋了為什麼它優於天真的SVD截斷。
